questions.question:
Create a PersistentVolume called `log-volume` with the following specifications:

- storageClassName: `manual`
- accessMode: `ReadWriteMany`
- capacity: `1Gi`
- hostPath path: `/opt/volume/nginx`

Next, create a PersistentVolumeClaim called `log-claim` requesting `200Mi` of storage with access mode `ReadWriteMany` and storage class `manual`. The claim must bind to `log-volume`.

Finally, create a pod called `logger` in the `default` namespace using the image `nginx:alpine` that mounts this claim at `/var/www/nginx`.

verification.description: PersistentVolume log-volume has 1Gi, ReadWriteMany, class manual and hostPath /opt/volume/nginx
PersistentVolumeClaim log-claim (200Mi, ReadWriteMany, manual) is Bound to log-volume
Pod logger mounts claim log-claim at /var/www/nginx and is Ready

questions.question:
A pod called `secure-pod` and a service called `secure-service` are deployed in the `default` namespace, but incoming connections to the pod are blocked by an existing default-deny NetworkPolicy.

Create a NetworkPolicy called `allow-webapp-color` in the `default` namespace that:

- selects the pods with the label `run=secure-pod`
- declares policy type `Ingress`
- allows ingress on TCP port `80` from pods with the label `name=webapp-color`

Do not delete or modify any existing objects.

verification.description: NetworkPolicy allow-webapp-color selects run=secure-pod with policy type Ingress
Ingress rule allows traffic from pods labeled name=webapp-color
Ingress rule allows TCP port 80
Existing objects (default-deny-all policy, secure-pod, secure-service) are untouched

questions.question:
Create a pod called `time-check` in the `dvl1987` namespace (create the namespace if it does not exist).

The pod should run a container called `time-check` using the `busybox` image with these requirements:

- An environment variable `TIME_FREQ` whose value comes from the key `TIME_FREQ` of a ConfigMap called `time-config` in the same namespace (create the ConfigMap with the value `10`)
- An `emptyDir` volume called `log-volume` mounted at `/opt/time`
- A command that runs in a shell and appends the current date to `/opt/time/time-check.log`, then sleeps for `$TIME_FREQ` seconds, looping forever

verification.description: Namespace dvl1987 exists and ConfigMap time-config has TIME_FREQ=10
Pod time-check gets TIME_FREQ from ConfigMap time-config key TIME_FREQ
emptyDir volume log-volume is mounted at /opt/time
Container command loops in a shell appending the date to /opt/time/time-check.log with sleep $TIME_FREQ

questions.question:
Create a deployment called `nginx-deploy` in the `default` namespace with one container using image `nginx:1.16` and `4` replicas.

The deployment must use the `RollingUpdate` strategy with `maxSurge=1` and `maxUnavailable=2`.

Next, upgrade the deployment to image `nginx:1.17`. Once all pods are updated, roll the deployment back to the previous version (`nginx:1.16`).

verification.description: Deployment nginx-deploy has 4 replicas with RollingUpdate strategy maxSurge=1 maxUnavailable=2
Rollout history records the image update (at least 2 revisions)
All nginx-deploy pods run nginx:1.16 again (rolled back) and 4 are available

questions.question:
Create a deployment called `redis` in the `default` namespace using the image `redis:alpine` with exactly `1` replica. The pods must carry the label `app=redis`.

The container must:

- request `200m` CPU (`0.2` CPU)
- expose port `6379`
- mount exactly 2 volumes:
  - an `emptyDir` volume called `data` at `/redis-master-data`
  - a ConfigMap volume called `config` referencing the ConfigMap `redis-config` (already created) at `/redis-master`

verification.description: Deployment redis has 1 replica, image redis:alpine and label app=redis
Container requests 200m CPU
emptyDir data mounted at /redis-master-data and ConfigMap redis-config mounted at /redis-master
Container exposes port 6379

questions.question:
The pod `nginx1401` in the `dev1401` namespace is not in a Ready state. Troubleshoot and fix the issue - the container serves HTTP on port `80`, but the readiness probe is configured against the wrong port.

Then add a liveness probe to the container that:

- runs the command `ls /var/www/html/file_check`
- starts after an initial delay of `10` seconds (`initialDelaySeconds`)
- runs every `60` seconds (`periodSeconds`)

You may delete and recreate the pod. Ignore any warnings the probes produce.

verification.description: Pod nginx1401 is Ready
Readiness probe uses HTTP GET on port 80
Liveness probe execs ls /var/www/html/file_check with initialDelaySeconds=10 and periodSeconds=60

questions.question:
Create a CronJob called `dice` in the `default` namespace:

- schedule: every one minute (`*/1 * * * *`)
- image: `kodekloud/throw-dice`
- the job must be non-parallel and complete the task exactly once (`completions: 1`)
- `backoffLimit: 25`

verification.description: CronJob dice runs every minute with image kodekloud/throw-dice
CronJob backoffLimit is 25
Job completions is 1

questions.question:
Create a pod called `my-busybox` in the `dev2406` namespace (create the namespace if it does not exist) using the `busybox` image.

- The container must be called `secret` and run `sleep 3600`
- Mount a **read-only** secret volume called `secret-volume` at `/etc/secret-volume` from the Secret `dotfile-secret` (already created in the namespace)
- The pod must be scheduled on the control-plane node `k3d-cluster-server-0` and no other node

verification.description: Container is named secret, uses busybox and runs sleep 3600
Secret dotfile-secret is mounted read-only at /etc/secret-volume via secret-volume
Pod is scheduled on node k3d-cluster-server-0 (nodeSelector and actual placement)

questions.question:
Create a single Ingress resource called `ingress-vh-routing` in the `default` namespace that routes HTTP traffic by hostname:

- `http://watch.ecom-store.com/video` → service `video-service` port `8080`
- `http://apparels.ecom-store.com/wear` → service `apparels-service` port `8080`

Add the annotation `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target=/`.

verification.description: Ingress ingress-vh-routing exists
Rule for watch.ecom-store.com routes path /video to video-service:8080
Rule for apparels.ecom-store.com routes path /wear to apparels-service:8080
Annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target=/ is set

questions.question:
A pod called `dev-pod-dind-878516` is running in the `default` namespace with a container called `log-x` whose log output contains `WARNING` lines.

Inspect the container logs and redirect all lines containing `WARNING` to the file `/tmp/exam/dind-878516_logs.txt` on `ckad9999`.

verification.description: File /tmp/exam/dind-878516_logs.txt exists and is not empty
Every line in the file contains WARNING
File line count does not exceed the WARNING lines currently in the container logs
